Class GradleProjectWorkspaceSession

java.lang.Object
dev.copperbench.core.workspace.project.GradleProjectWorkspaceSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
WorkspaceSession, AutoCloseable
public final class GradleProjectWorkspaceSession extends Object implements WorkspaceSession
Attaches the application service to a Gradle project Copperbench did not create (ADR-0020). Identity and revision live in .copperbench/workspace.json; every file stays hand-written and no project file is changed by opening.

  • Method Details

    • open

      public static GradleProjectWorkspaceSession open(Path folder, GradleProjectWorkspaceSession.TaskFactory taskFactory, Clock clock, Supplier<UUID> ids) throws IOException
      Opens the project for this session. Only .copperbench/ is written, and only one session can hold it. The session owns the gateway taskFactory creates and closes it before its history and lease.
      Throws:
      GradleProjectDetector.NotAProjectException - when the folder is not a Gradle project to adopt
      WorkspaceWriteLockedException - when another session already has the project open
      IOException
